name: Dun Algaz
summary: Dragonmaw orcs have seized Dun Algaz, closing the easy road between Ironforge's lands and Menethil Harbor. Its guarded pass and tunnels join Loch Modan to the Wetlands.

sections.title: A Chokepoint Between Realms
sections.body: Dun Algaz cuts through the jagged peaks between Loch Modan and the Wetlands. The pass was already there before the War of the Three Hammers. After the Wildhammer clan was driven from Ironforge, its people traveled this way north. Stone tunnels, bastions, and watchposts guard the road. Whoever holds Dun Algaz commands the only overland route from the dwarven heartlands to Menethil Harbor on the western sea.

sections.title: The Dragonmaw Resurgence
sections.body: After their defeat at Dun Modr in the Second War, the Old Horde retreated to Dun Algaz. The pass became their last southern bulwark against Sir Anduin Lothar's forces. The Alliance took it back for a time, but Dragonmaw orcs have overrun the stronghold again. Dwarven Mountaineers have withdrawn to the upper tunnels, leaving a deadly gauntlet for travelers through the mountain corridor.

faq.q: Why is Dun Algaz so dangerous right now?
aliases: why are there orcs in dun algaz
faq.answer: Dragonmaw orcs have come down from the surrounding mountains and seized the lower pass and stronghold. Dwarven Mountaineers have been driven back to the upper pass near Algaz Station. The main road now swarms with hostile orcs who ambush travelers between Loch Modan and the Wetlands.

faq.q: Why is this pass so important to the dwarves?
aliases: why does ironforge need dun algaz
faq.answer: Dun Algaz is the main overland route from Ironforge and Loch Modan to Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Menethil Harbor is Khaz Modan's main shipping gateway to the rest of the Alliance territories, so the pass is vital for supplies, troops, and trade.

faq.q: Did Dun Algaz play a role in the Second War?
faq.answer: Yes. After their defeat at Dun Modr, the Orcish Horde withdrew across the Thandol Valley and made Dun Algaz a defensive stronghold. Sir Anduin Lothar ordered an assault to drive them from Khaz Modan, but the Alliance could not root out the Horde completely. Dun Algaz remained among its final strongholds in the region.

faq.q: What is the history between Dun Algaz and the Wildhammer dwarves?
aliases: war of the three hammers pass
faq.answer: Long before the Second War, the Wildhammer dwarves were driven from Ironforge during the ancient War of the Three Hammers. They traveled through Dun Algaz on their way north into the Wetlands, and eventually settled in Grim Batol.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know Dun Algaz as an ancestral highway cut through the spine of Khaz Modan. Dragonmaw orcs now hold its dwarven bastions and threaten the supply lines to Menethil Harbor. Their occupation is an ongoing insult and a threat to security.
For the Alliance, Dun Algaz is a vital route for supplies and troops, joining Menethil Harbor with Loch Modan and Ironforge.
